blocks.text:
The morning tour starts at 6:15 a.m. as Tortuguero comes to life. It’s a good time to watch for wildlife and birds.

After the outing, return for breakfast, served from 7:00 to 9:00 a.m. Then continue to the northern lowlands around Arenal Volcano and the town of La Fortuna.

Relax in the hot springs in the Arenal area. Overnight at Arenal Paraíso Resort & Spa.

**Meals:** Breakfast.
A calm river reflecting the rainforest in Tortuguero, Costa Rica
Tortuguero: green riverbanks and clouds reflected in the water

In the morning, head to Místico Park to explore Arenal’s forest bridges. The route winds through tropical rainforest near the volcano and is suitable for people with different fitness levels. The trails cover about 2 miles in total, and the walk takes around 2.5 hours.

The trails and bridges let you see the forest at different heights and get closer to areas where you can spot birds, flowers and plants typical of the area. The route crosses 15 bridges, 6 of them hanging bridges. Some sections offer views of Arenal Volcano and the treetops.

In the afternoon, continue to Arenal 1968 Volcano Park and reserves bordering the national park. Most of these trails are suited to a leisurely walk with a nature guide. Lava from the 1968 eruption destroyed part of the area, and you can see how the vegetation differs from one section to the next.

The 1968 trail looks out over Arenal Volcano, Lake Arenal and the extinct Cerro Chato volcano. The route is chosen for its wildlife-watching opportunities. In wooded sections, your guide will help you spot birds, monkeys and other animals in their natural habitat.

Overnight at Arenal Paraíso Resort & Spa.

**Meals:** Breakfast.
